# Hassan Jatoi — Digital Portfolio & Global Directory

## About
Hassan Jatoi is a Poet, Author, and Digital Architect & Consultant from Pakistan. This website is a comprehensive AI-powered directory covering Europass CV services, 80+ international job portals, 30+ scholarship programs, remote jobs, visa guides for 60+ countries, government jobs, UN careers, scam protection resources, and poetry publications.

- Europass CV Writing — Professional Europass standard CV creation and formatting

- Website Design — Custom website design and development

- FBR Tax NTN File — FBR tax filing and NTN registration assistance
- IT Consulting — Computer IT specialist consulting services
